title: Hussain-lab-05
text:
The NMES1988 data describe 4,406 adults aged 66 and older from the 1987–1988 US National Medical Expenditure Survey. It details several variables with the outcome variable being number of physician office visits. The rest are listed below







Variable
Description




visits
Outcome: physician office visits between 1987 and 1988


chronic
Number of chronic conditions


health
Self-perceived health: poor, average, or excellent


gender
male of female


school
Years of education


insurance
Covered by private insurance: no or yes



Reference groups are Average health, Male, and No insurance.

The visits outcome is a count. Whole numbers, bounded at zero, and right-skewed. The variance (45.69) is about 7.91 times the mean (5.77). 16% of people had no visits. The greatest number of visits reported is (89) This is a shockingly large number, but could be legitimate.
